summary.oneLiner: India's fastest growing packaged food company (among those with revenue above ₹15,000 million), exclusively focused on premium value-added dairy products under the 'Milky Mist' brand with an integrated farm-to-retail model built around a single Perundurai (Tamil Nadu) facility.
summary.business: Milky Mist manufactures and sells value-added dairy products - paneer, cheese, curd, butter, ghee, yogurt, ice cream and UHT long-shelf-life products - plus frozen foods, ready-to-eat/ready-to-cook meals and chocolates, offered under the umbrella brand 'Milky Mist' and sub-brands 'SmartChef', 'Capella', 'Misty Lite', 'Briyas' and 'Asal'. It sources raw milk directly from 74,654 farmers across 25 districts (all within a 400 km radius of its Perundurai plant) and processes it at a single U.S. FDA-approved manufacturing facility.
